old_caption: The video captures a controlled burn in a grassy area bordered by trees. Flames lick at the dry grass, which is partially consumed, leaving charred remnants behind. Smoke billows into the air, thickening as it rises, creating a hazy atmosphere. In the background, several people are visible, some standing near the edge of the burning area, observing the process. The setting is an open field with sparse trees, suggesting a rural or semi-rural environment. The sky is overcast, adding a somber tone to the scene. The fire and smoke show visible advancement and changes in density across the sampled frames.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a dramatic scene of a controlled burn in a grassy area bordered by trees. Flames lick at the dry grass, which is partially consumed, leaving charred remnants behind. Smoke billows into the air, thickening as it rises, creating a hazy atmosphere. In the background, several people are visible, some standing near the edge of the burning area, observing the process. Others appear to be actively managing the fire, using tools like shovels or rakes to control its spread. The setting is an open field with sparse trees, suggesting a rural or semi-rural environment. The sky is overcast, adding a somber tone to the scene. As the video progresses, the fire continues to advance, consuming more of the grass, while the smoke grows denser, eventually obscuring parts of the landscape. The people remain engaged in their tasks, ensuring the fire stays within safe boundaries.
caption: The video captures an ongoing ground fire consuming a strip of dry vegetation beside a line of bare trees. Active orange flames flicker and reshape themselves along the blackened edge, rising and falling in height. A dense white-gray smoke cloud billows upward on the right, partly obscuring distant trees and buildings, with occasional orange glow visible through the haze. The burning fringe along the left side of the charred strip appears brighter and more continuous. A person in a yellow jacket stands near the tree line, while a second figure in dark clothing becomes visible at the far left edge. The background and the pink marker drift slowly rightward, indicating a gradual shift of viewpoint. Smoke density and shape change continuously throughout. The flames remain smoldering and active without any visible conclusion.
